newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money rates close down on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money rates close down on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates closed down on Sunday due to excess liquidity, dealers said, adding that rates were likely to open lower on Monday.
Overnight call rates opened at 5.00 percent and closed at 2.00 amid surplus funds and little borrowing interest, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank in Karachi said.
"At the end of the day, some activity was seen in one-month repos at 11.25 to 11.30 percent," the dealer said.
